Fairide restaurant screens

Fairide mockups · 17 October 2026

Bringing the Fairide look to the restaurant list and the restaurant page

Each row starts with a real screenshot of the app as it is today, then three directions. Every function stays where it is: only the styling changes. Phones scroll inside. Names, dishes and prices are examples.

Restaurant listRestaurant pageOther plain screens
Why these two screens feel genericThe iris band stops after the address. Below it, the cards, titles and buttons use plain grey borders and system-style type, so the page could belong to any delivery app.
What gives the other screens their feelIris band with a white sheet rising over it, the bike on its dashed road, the brand typeface for titles, iris-tinted surfaces instead of grey boxes, and one lime accent.
What the proposals addThe brand typeface on restaurant names and section titles, borderless cards, the dashed road as a divider, the iris band carried into the restaurant page, and a short line about Fairide's 10 %.

Restaurant list

The approved top (address above the glass chip strip, shrinking on scroll, no search bar) stays in all three. The changes are below it.

A greeting in the brand typeface rides in the band (it folds away on scroll like the address). Borderless cards, names in Bricolage, titles underlined by the dashed road. A small card explains the 10 %.

Restaurant page

Same content as today: photo, name, rating, opening hours, delivery or pickup, group order, the opening-date notice, the glass section strip and the dishes. The glass cart bar shows how the screen looks with two items.

TodayCurrent app

Full photo, then a stack of grey pills, a grey notice box and an outlined button. Dish names and section titles in plain type; an empty "Allergènes :" line on each dish.

APhoto in the band

The iris band comes back: the photo sits inside it as a framed card, name in big Bricolage on iris. Status, rating and info become pills on the band; the sheet keeps only what you act on.

3 articles de Chez Simone seront retirés
  • Not mocked here: the Map tab (glass controls over a city map, an accepted exception to the white or iris rule) and the order tracking screen (already restyled with the iris band, 1C).
  • Small things spotted on the way: the restaurant page shows "Allergènes :" with nothing after it when a dish's allergen list is empty or not recognised, and promo prices are struck through (13,50 € with a line). The proposals show "avant 13,50 €" in plain text instead.
  • Business and courier screens were not screenshotted this time. The earlier "all screens" mockup covered them; tell me if any of them also feel off.
